name: 2021-1c-recuperatorio
title: Truco: envido and a game of several rounds
description: Starting from a finished model of a two-player truco round (cards, round, player), the student must add with TDD a simplified envido (who may call it and when, wanting or not wanting it, declaring valid envido sums, 2 or 1 points) and a Truco game that plays rounds until a player reaches 30 points, counting envido points and one point per round won.

design.notes: The envido adds a second state machine (called, wanted or not, sums declared in mano-first order) on top of the round's turn logic, the envido sum is a small collection computation over a hand grouped by suit, and the student must understand a sizable given round model (three alternative designs are offered) before extending it and wrapping it in a multi-round game.
